additions.description: אורזילא בר-יומא = כבוד שהוא בעכו"ם בזלותא (Kavod in exile/degradation among the nations)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 18): 'אוּרְזִילָא בַּר-יוֹמָא הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת כָּבוֹד, שֶׁהוּא בָּעַכּוּ"ם, בְּזִּלוּתָא. וְזֶה: אוּר זִילָא'
additions.notes: The Rebbe explains the Aramaic: אוּר = כבוד (light = glory), זִילָא = זִלוּתָא (degradation). This is the exiled-kavod concept. Would join Package 1 (Kavod).

additions.description: הר תבור = גדלות (mountain of pride/greatness = Tabor = שבירה — breaking of pride)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 19): 'הַר תָּבוֹר — הַר לְשׁוֹן גַּדְלוּת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: הֶעֱמַדְתָּ לְהַרְרִי עֹז, וְתָבוֹר לְשׁוֹן שְׁבִירָה'
additions.notes: Har Tabor is a bechina of pride-breaking: הר = greatness, תבור = breaking. This equates the metaphor to the act of humbling pride which enables Kavod to rise. Would join Package 1 (Kavod domain — as the mechanism of its elevation through humility).

additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 22): 'מַרְבַּעְתָּא — לְשׁוֹן זִוּוּג, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: אָרְחִי וְרִבְעִי'
additions.notes: מרבעתא (resting/squaring) = זיווג (coupling). This would add another synonym to the זווג node already in Package 1, strengthening the soul-sparking cluster.

additions.description: פרסה שלמה = המשכת הנשמות לבנים (a complete parsah = drawing bright souls to one's children)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 22): 'פַּרְסָה, זֶה רֶמֶז עַל הַמְשָׁכַת הַנְּשָׁמוֹת לִבְנֵיהֶם, זֶה מְכֻנֶּה בְּשֵׁם פַּרְסָה שְׁלֵמָה'
additions.notes: פרסה שלמה is a bechina of the complete transmission of souls (bright neshamot to children). This is in the kavod/zivug domain (Package 1) — it is the positive outcome of the zivug in thought, as opposed to the פלגא (incomplete, for sinners/converts).

additions.description: פלגא = התנוצצות שמעוררת פושעי ישראל בתשובה ומולידה נשמות גרים (a half-parsah = the sparking that arouses sinners to repentance and generates converts' souls)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 22): 'וְהִתְנוֹצְצוּת שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמוֹת מִתְנוֹצְצִין... וּמוֹלִידִין נִשְׁמוֹת גֵּרִים, זֶה מְכֻנֶּה בְּשֵׁם פַּלְגָּא'

proposed_edge.node2_id: התנוצצות המעוררת פושעים בתשובה ומולידה נשמות גרים

additions.notes: פלגא (half-parsah) = the partial/incomplete sparking toward those still far from holiness (sinners + converts). Same kavod-elevation domain as the זווג cluster in Package 1.

additions.description: גלגלא דרקיעא דהדרא = גלגולין דנשמתין (the rotating celestial sphere = transmigration of souls)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ט (line 43): 'גַּלְגַּלָּא דִּרְקִיעַ דְּהַדְרָא — הַיְנוּ גִּלְגּוּלִין דְּנִשְׁמָתִין, הִיא הַגּוֹרֶמֶת שֶׁאֵין לַצַּדִּיק כְּדֵי פַּרְנָסָתוֹ'
additions.notes: The rotating sphere = soul-transmigration. This would join Package 3 (soul domain) since נשמה is the dominant concept there.

additions.description: תקעו = שלום (the word תקעו connotes peace — anchoring/planting in a firm place)
additions.source_text_ref: Section י (line 46): 'תִּקְעוּ — לְשׁוֹן שָׁלוֹם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: וּתְקַעְתִּיו יָתֵד בְּמָקוֹם נֶאֱמָן'
additions.notes: תקעו (the blowing of the shofar) carries the connotation of שלום — stability, planting in a firm place. Would join Package 3 (Shalom domain).

additions.source_text_ref: Section י (line 50): 'חַגֵּנוּ — זֶה בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה, עֲבוֹדָה'
additions.notes: חגנו (our festival) = תפלה (prayer/divine service). Would reinforce Package 4 (Tefillah).

additions.description: יציאת הכוכבים = מצדיקי הרבים ככוכבים (the going-out of the stars = those who make the many righteous)
additions.source_text_ref: Section יב (line 60): 'יְצִיאַת הַכּוֹכָבִים זֶה בְּחִינַת (דניאל יב): מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים כַּכּוֹכָבִים; דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁהֵם מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים וְעוֹשִׂין בַּעֲלֵי-תְּשׁוּבָה וְגֵרִים'
additions.notes: Stars going out = those who make the many righteous (bring to teshuvah). This is the mechanism of kavod's illumination — same domain as Package 1.

structural_observations: Torah 14 has a well-defined 5-package structure mirroring the teaching's core argument: Kavod (Package 1) must return to its root Yirah (Package 2), yielding Shalom/body-soul peace (Package 3), enabling Tefillah (Package 4), against the evil mirror of Machlokes (Package 5).

The good/evil mirror is clear: Package 3 (Shalom = body-soul harmony) mirrors Package 5 (Machlokes = body-soul war); Package 1 (Kavod's light) mirrors the unencoded concept of כבוד בגלות (kavod in degradation among the nations).
The dataset has 22 bechina edges covering 38 unique nodes, yielding 16 raw components that consolidate to 5 packages after merging.

The Raba bar bar Chana allegory (section ה-ט) is heavily mined for bechina equalities and most of its key equations ARE in the dataset, though the Aramaic metaphors (מרבעתא, פרסה, פלגא, גלגלא) are underrepresented.
